extension.summary: Play YouTube links resolved by yt-dlp through InputStream Adaptive
extension.description: Resolves a YouTube video to its HLS master manifest with yt-dlp and hands that single URL to InputStream Adaptive, which gives seeking and bitrate switching without downloading the file. Meant to be selected as TubeCast's playback add-on, but works standalone via plugin://plugin.video.ytdlpcast/?video_id=ID
